english: A distracting melody momentarily fills a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target loses {@status Concentration|XPHB}, and it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} for the spell's duration.
translated: 一段擾亂心神的旋律短暫迴盪在以施法距離內你選擇的一點為中心、半徑20尺的{@variantrule 球狀 [效應區域]|XPHB|球狀}區域。{@variantrule 球狀 [效應區域]|XPHB|球狀}區域內的所有生物都必須進行一次體質豁免。豁免失敗者失去{@status 專注|XPHB}，且在法術持續時間內為維持{@status 專注|XPHB}而進行的體質豁免具有{@variantrule 劣勢|XPHB}。

english: A creature that takes a {@action Study|XPHB} action to examine the dragon can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to end the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition it caused and to resist its exhalation.
translated: 若生物執行{@action 研究|XPHB}動作併成功進行一次對抗你的法術豁免DC的智力（{@skill 調查|XPHB}）檢定，便可辨明其是否為幻象。如果生物識別了幻象的虛實，則其便能看穿幻影，並在結束其造成的{@condition 恐慌|XPHB}狀態和對抗其吐息的豁免檢定中具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}。

english: The soul fragment flies into an Undead creature of your choice that you can see within 60 feet of yourself. That creature regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 4d8} plus your spellcasting ability modifier.
translated: 該靈魂碎片飛入60尺內你選擇的一名你可見的亡靈生物體內。該生物恢復等於{@dice 4d8}+你的施法屬性調整值的{@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}。

english: You can take the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
translated: 你能以{@variantrule 附贈動作|XPHB}執行{@action 迴避|XPHB}動作。你能使用此增益的次數等於你的{@variantrule 熟練|XPHB|熟練加值}，當你完成{@variantrule 長休|XPHB}時重獲所有已消耗的使用次數。

english: You learn the {@spell Resistance|XPHB} cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). You can cast the {@spell Resistance|XPHB} cantrip as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. You can do so a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
translated: 你習得{@spell 抵抗術|XPHB}戲法。智力、感知或魅力是你施展該法術的施法屬性（在你選取此專長時選擇）。你能以{@variantrule 附贈動作|XPHB}施展{@spell 抵抗術|XPHB}戲法。你能如此做的次數等於你的{@variantrule 熟練|XPHB|熟練加值}，當你完成{@variantrule 長休|XPHB}時重獲所有已消耗的使用次數。

english: When you cast a spell from the Illusion school using a spell slot, you can cast it without any Verbal, Somatic, or Material components, except Material components that are consumed by the spell or that have a cost specified in the spell. Additionally, creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) checks made to discern the true nature of illusions created by your spells.
translated: 當你使用法術位施展一道來自幻術學派的法術時，你施展該法術時可以無需任意言語、姿勢或材料成分，除非該材料成分會被該法術消耗或在法術中具有指定的價值。此外，生物為識破你的法術所創造幻象的真實本質而進行的智力（{@skill 調查|XPHB}）檢定具有{@variantrule 劣勢|XPHB}。

english: After you cast a spell that has a casting time of an action using a spell slot, you can take both the {@action Dash|XPHB} and {@action Hide|XPHB} actions as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
translated: 在你使用法術位施展一道施法時間為一個動作的法術後，你能以{@variantrule 附贈動作|XPHB}同時執行{@action 疾走|XPHB}和{@action 躲藏|XPHB}動作。你能使用此增益的次數等於你以此專長提升屬性的調整值，當你完成{@variantrule 長休|XPHB}時重獲所有已消耗的使用次數。

english: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Poison damage. You also have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition.
translated: 你具有毒素傷害的{@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|抗性}。此外，你為避免/結束{@condition Poisoned|XPHB|中毒}狀態所做的豁免檢定具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。

english: While holding the staff, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intelligence ({@skill Arcana|XPHB}) checks.
translated: 當你持握此法杖時，你在智力（{@skill 奧秘|XPHB}）檢定上具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}。

english: When you hit a {@status Concentration|XPHB|Concentrating} creature with an attack roll using this weapon and deal damage, the creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the saving throw it makes to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB}.
translated: 當你使用該武器進行攻擊檢定命中一個{@status 專注|XPHB|專注於}的生物並造成傷害時，該生物為維持{@status 專注|XPHB}而進行的豁免檢定具有{@variantrule 劣勢|XPHB}。

english: While you hold the staff, you can cast {@spell Chill Touch|XPHB} from it, using your spell attack bonus. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Intimidation|XPHB}) checks made while holding the staff, and the staff's eye sockets glow a disquieting green, shedding {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} in a 5-foot radius.
translated: 持握此法杖期間，你可以從中施展{@spell 顫慄之觸|XPHB}，使用你的法術攻擊加值。此外，持握此法杖期間，你的魅力（{@skill 威嚇|XPHB}）檢定具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}，法杖上的骷髏頭眼窩會散發出令人不安的綠光，提供半徑5尺的{@variantrule 微光光照|XPHB}。

english: While the nightingale sings, the effect of a {@spell Zone of Truth|XPHB} spell (save {@dc 18}) fills a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the nightingale. While attuned to the nightingale, you know which creatures succeed on or fail the saving throw against this effect.
translated: 夜鶯歌唱期間，源自該夜鶯的15尺{@variantrule 光環 [效應區域]|XPHB|光環}區域內會充滿法術{@spell 誠實之域|XPHB}的效應（豁免{@dc 18}）。與夜鶯同調期間，你會知曉哪些生物在對抗該效應的豁免檢定中成功或失敗。

english: When you use your Arcane Recovery feature, you also regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 2d6} plus half your Wizard level (round down).
translated: 當你使用你的奧術回想特性時，你還恢復等同於{@dice 2d6}加你法師等級一半（向下取整）數值的{@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}。

english: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action while holding the censer, you can cause magical smoke to billow from the censer, filling a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the censer for 1 hour or until you end it (no action required). The area of the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} is {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB}, and creatures of your choice (including yourself) gain the benefits of the {@spell Protection from Evil and Good|XPHB} spell while within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.
translated: 持握該香爐期間，你可以執行{@action 魔法|XPHB}動作，使魔法煙霧從香爐中滾滾湧出，充滿源自該香爐的30尺{@variantrule 光環 [效應區域]|XPHB|光環}區域，持續1小時，或直至你結束它（無需動作）。該{@variantrule 光環 [效應區域]|XPHB|光環}區域處於{@variantrule 輕度遮蔽|XPHB}，且你選擇的生物（包括你自己）處於該{@variantrule 光環 [效應區域]|XPHB|光環}內時，獲得{@spell 防護善惡|XPHB}法術的增益。該詞條一經使用，則直至下一黎明前，都無法再次使用。

english: While attuned to this staff, you never know which way is north, and you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Survival|XPHB}) checks made to navigate. Additionally, whenever you expend a charge from the staff, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, {@dice 1d4} {@creature Minotaur of Baphomet|XMM|minotaurs of Baphomet} materialize, each appearing in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you. The minotaurs begin combat with you immediately.
translated: 當你與此法杖同調時，你永遠無法分辨哪邊是北方，並且在用於導航的感知（{@skill 求生|XPHB}）檢定上具有{@variantrule 劣勢|XPHB}。此外，每當你消耗此法杖的一個充能時，擲{@dice 1d20}。若結果為1，則{@dice 1d4}個{@creature 巴弗滅的牛頭人|XMM|巴弗滅的牛頭人}會具現化，每個出現在你30尺內一個未被佔據的空間中。這些牛頭人立即與你開始戰鬥。

english: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action while holding the {@item staff|XPHB}, you can cause it to radiate supernatural power that fills a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you. Creatures of your choice in this {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} (including yourself) gain the following benefits:
translated: 持握該{@item 法杖|XPHB}期間，你可以執行{@action 魔法|XPHB}動作，使其散發出超自然之力，充滿一處源自你的30尺{@variantrule 光環 [效應區域]|XPHB|光環}區域。該{@variantrule 光環 [效應區域]|XPHB|光環}內你選擇的生物（包括你自己）獲得以下增益：

english: The creatures have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold, Necrotic, and Psychic damage, and they have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.
translated: 它們具有寒冷、暗蝕和心靈傷害的{@variantrule 抗性|XPHB}，並且它們為避免或結束{@condition 恐慌|XPHB}狀態而進行的豁免檢定具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}。

english: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} while holding the {@item staff|XPHB}, you can cause the eye sockets of the skull atop the {@item staff|XPHB} to emit an unearthly glow; this glow lasts until you stop it (no action required). While the {@item staff|XPHB} glows, it sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 15-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 15 feet. {@condition Invisible|XPHB} creatures and objects are visible as long as they are in the {@item staff|XPHB}'s {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB}.
translated: 持握該{@item 法杖|XPHB}期間，你可以使用{@variantrule 附贈動作|XPHB}使該{@item 法杖|XPHB}頂端頭骨的眼窩發出超自然的光芒；該光芒持續至你將其停止（無需動作）。該{@item 法杖|XPHB}發光期間，其發出半徑15尺的{@variantrule 明亮光照|XPHB}以及額外15尺的{@variantrule 微光光照|XPHB}。只要{@condition 隱形|XPHB}的生物和物件處於該{@item 法杖|XPHB}的{@variantrule 明亮光照|XPHB}或{@variantrule 微光光照|XPHB}內，它們就是可見的。

english: If the taisus dies, its body crumbles into glittering dust. It gains a new body after {@dice 1d10} days, reviving with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, unless a {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell is cast on its remains to prevent the effects of this trait. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a location designated by the taisus on its creation.
translated: 若泰修斯死亡，其軀體崩解為閃光的塵埃。除非有人對其遺骸施展{@spell 祈願術|XPHB}以阻止此特性的效應，否則其會在{@dice 1d10}天后獲得新的軀體，並以全部{@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}復活。新軀體出現於泰修斯被創造時所指定位置5尺內的一處未佔據空間。

english: The vestige touches another creature. The target regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 2d8} plus your Charisma modifier and ends one condition on it: {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, or {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}.
translated: 契靈觸碰另一名生物。目標恢復等於{@dice 2d8}外加你的魅力調整值的{@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}，並終止其身上的一種狀態：{@condition 目盲|XPHB}、{@condition 耳聾|XPHB}或{@condition 中毒|XPHB}。

english: The vestige touches another creature. The target regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 2d8} plus your Charisma modifier and ends one condition on it: {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, or {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}.
translated: 契靈觸碰另一名生物。目標恢復等於{@dice 2d8}外加你的魅力調整值的{@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}，並終止其身上的一種狀態：{@condition 目盲|XPHB}、{@condition 耳聾|XPHB}或{@condition 中毒|XPHB}。

english: An immortal mage and Fiend with an implacable hatred for {@book Tiamat|XDMG|8|Tiamat}, {@creature Venger|AU} seeks to rule nations by amassing sycophants and long-lost magical artifacts. Though his bat-like wings allow him to fly, {@creature Venger|AU} prefers to ride on his trusted flying steed, a {@creature Nightmare|XMM} that lurks on the Ethereal Plane until it's needed. {@creature Venger|AU} sends his adviser, {@creature Shadow Demon|XMM}, to survey distant lands, then weaves interlocking plans based on Shadow Demon's reports.
translated: 作為一位不朽的法師與邪魔，{@creature 文格爾|AU}對{@book 提亞馬特|XDMG|8|提亞馬特}懷有不共戴天的仇恨，他試圖透過聚集阿諛之徒與收羅失傳已久的魔法神器來統治諸國。儘管蝙蝠般的雙翼令他能夠飛行，{@creature 文格爾|AU}更願意騎乘他信賴的飛行坐騎——一頭潛伏在以太位面、待命而出的{@creature 夢魘|XMM}。{@creature 文格爾|AU}派遣其顧問{@creature 幽影惡魔|XMM}去勘察遠方之地，再依據幽影惡魔的報告編織環環相扣的計劃。

english: To represent this defilement, you can use the optional rule on {@variantrule planar effects||abyssal corruption} in chapter 2 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|dmg}, causing the {@condition poisoned} creature to be corrupted.
translated: 為了表現這種汙染，你可以使用{@book 城主指南|dmg}第2章中關於{@variantrule planar effects||深淵墮落}的可選規則，使得{@condition poisoned||中毒}的生物被腐化。

english: Taking damage can't break your {@status Concentration|XPHB} on {@filter Conjuration spells|spells|school=C}.
translated: 受到傷害無法打斷你對{@filter 咒法法術|spells|school=C}的{@status 專注|XPHB}。

english: You can make a creature unaware of your magical influence. When you cast an {@filter Enchantment spell|spells|school=E} that imposes the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition using a spell slot, you can choose one creature targeted by the spell. That creature remains unaware of being {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by you.
translated: 你可以讓一個生物察覺不到你的魔法影響。當你使用法術位施展一個會使目標陷入{@condition 魅惑|XPHB}狀態的{@filter 惑控法術|spells|school=E}時，你可以選擇該法術的一個目標。該生物始終不會意識到自己被你{@condition 魅惑|XPHB}。

english: While underwater, you can take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.
translated: 位於水下時，你可以用{@variantrule 附贈動作|XPHB}執行{@action 疾走|XPHB}動作。

english: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB}) checks.
translated: 你進行的魅力（{@skill 欺瞞|XPHB}）檢定具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}。

english: The damage of your new growth increases to {@dice 2d6} damage of the type associated with the growth. You also have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB}.
translated: 你新長出來的身體器官所造成的傷害提升至{@dice 2d6}，傷害型別保持不變。同時，你對維持{@status 專注|XPHB}所進行的體質豁免具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}。

english: In combat, the vestige acts during your turn. It can move and use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} on its own, but the only action it takes is the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action unless you take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to command it to take an action in its stat block or some other action. You can also sacrifice one of your attacks when you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action to command the vestige to take the Vestige's Strike action. If you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, the vestige acts on its own and isn't limited to the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action.
translated: 在戰鬥中，契靈在你的回合內行動。其可以自主移動或使用其{@variantrule 反應|XPHB}，但除非你以一個{@variantrule 附贈動作|XPHB}指揮它執行其資料卡中的動作或其他動作，否則其只會執行{@action 迴避|XPHB}動作。當你執行{@action 攻擊|XPHB}動作時，你也可以放棄其中一次攻擊，轉而指揮契靈執行契靈打擊動作。如果你陷入{@condition 失能|XPHB}狀態，契靈將自行行動，且不再受限於僅能執行{@action 迴避|XPHB}動作。

english: Your {@creature Vestige Companion|AU} now regains its use of Divine Power whenever you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} or when you use your Magical Cunning feature. In addition, while within 30 feet of your {@creature Vestige Companion|AU}, you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the same damage types as the vestige.
translated: 現在，每當你完成一次{@variantrule 短休|XPHB|短}或{@variantrule 長休|XPHB}，或當你使用你的秘法迴流特性時，你的{@creature 契靈夥伴|AU}都會恢復其神聖之力的使用次數。此外，當你位於你的{@creature 契靈夥伴|AU}30尺範圍內時，你對與該契靈相同的傷害型別具有{@variantrule 抗性|XPHB}。

english: One target of the spell gains a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 2d8} plus your Cleric level.
translated: 此法術的其中一個目標獲得等於{@dice 2d8}加你的牧師等級的{@variantrule 臨時生命值|XPHB}。

english: Immediately after you cast a spell with a spell slot that restores {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to a creature or ends a condition on a creature, you can cast {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} as part of that action, {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, or {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, and without expending a spell slot.
translated: 在你使用法術位施展了一道恢復生物{@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}或終止生物身上狀態的法術時，作為該動作、{@variantrule 附贈動作|XPHB}或{@variantrule 反應|XPHB}的一部分，你可以立即無需消耗法術位地施展{@spell 解除魔法|XPHB}。

english: {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Intimidation|XPHB}) checks
translated: 魅力（{@skill 威嚇|XPHB}）檢定具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}

english: {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB}) checks
translated: 魅力（{@skill 欺瞞|XPHB}）檢定具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}

english: {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks
translated: 感知（{@skill 察覺|XPHB}）檢定具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}

english: {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|XPHB}) checks
translated: 感知（{@skill 醫藥|XPHB}）檢定具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}

english: {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks
translated: 敏捷（{@skill 隱匿|XPHB}）檢定具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}

english: {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand|XPHB}) checks
translated: 敏捷（{@skill 巧手|XPHB}）檢定具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}

english: A group of sirens (see the {@creature Harpy||harpies} entry in {@area chapter 6|031|x}) take over the temple and lure new victims inside to drown themselves during high tide.
translated: 一群塞壬（見{@area 第六章|031|x}中的{@creature 鳥妖||鳥妖}條目）佔據了廟宇，誘惑新的受害者進入這裡，然後把他們溺死在漲潮時刻。

english: In the wilderness on their home world, the characters find a {@item spelljamming helm|AAG} in the wreckage of a crashed {@vehicle scorpion ship|AAG} and run afoul of goblins who want to plunder the wreck.
translated: 角色們在故鄉世界的荒野中，於一艘墜毀的{@vehicle 蠍艦|AAG}殘骸裡發現了一個{@item 法驅魔舵|AAG}，並與想要洗劫殘骸的地精們發生了衝突。

english: A {@creature hadozee explorer|BAM} (see {@book Boo's Astral Menagerie|BAM}) needs the characters' help to slay a white {@creature kindori|BAM} (see {@book Boo's Astral Menagerie|BAM}) that keeps attacking her {@vehicle flying fish ship|AAG}. The hadozee can't tell whether the kindori is mean-spirited or amorous. Perhaps it has mistaken the ship for a rival—or a mate!
translated: 一位{@creature 鼯猴人探索者|BAM}（參見{@book 布布的星界怪獸展|BAM}）需要角色們幫助她擊殺一隻不斷攻擊她{@vehicle 飛魚艦|AAG}的白色{@creature 鯨馱驪|BAM}（參見{@book 布布的星界怪獸展|BAM}）。這位哈多茲鼯猴人無法判斷這隻鯨馱驪是心懷惡意還是求偶示愛。也許它把這艘船誤認成了競爭對手——或是配偶！

english: A {@creature beholder} influenced by {@area the Abyss|00b|x} has compound eyes and looks like a floating, cyclopean fly head. It promises not to destroy the characters if they bring it a corpse it has never tasted before.
translated: 一隻被{@area 無底深淵|00b|x}所影響的{@creature 眼魔}擁有複眼且看起來像一顆漂浮的蒼蠅頭。它承諾如果角色們可以帶給其一具其從未嘗過的屍體，則不會殺死角色們。

english: A {@creature triceratops} influenced by {@area Mechanus|03d|x} and composed of simple geometric shapes charges creatures that enter the angular canyons it inhabits. It moves only in straight lines and turns only at right angles.
translated: 一隻被{@area 機械境|03d|x}所影響的、由簡單幾何外形所構成的{@creature 三角龍}會向進入其所棲息的稜角峽谷的生物衝撞而來。它只會走直線且轉向只會在直角處轉彎。

english: A desiccated {@creature giant frog} influenced by {@area Pandemonium|049|x} screams whenever it opens its mouth. Its interior is even noisier.
translated: 一個被{@area 喧癲空隧|049|x}所影響的乾癟的{@creature 巨蛙}每當開口時都會尖叫，而其體內更加嘈雜。

english: Wearing grim armor and displaying a rust-colored horn, a {@creature unicorn} influenced by {@area Acheron|010|x} challenges all it encounters to mortal combat.
translated: 一隻被{@area 修羅場|010|x}所影響的穿著醜陋盔甲、展露著鐵鏽色的角的{@creature 獨角獸}，向所有其遇到的生物發起殊死搏鬥的挑戰。

english: A {@creature couatl} influenced by {@area Limbo|038|x} has color-changing wings and insists passersby convince it that they're worthy of existing. If the couatl isn't convinced, it has a 50 percent chance of either attacking or wandering off.
translated: 一隻被{@area 混沌海|038|x}所影響的、有著色彩變幻的羽翼的{@creature 羽蛇}堅持要求過路人向其說服自己有存活的價值。如果羽蛇未被說服，則其有50%的機會進行攻擊或是離開。

english: A beautiful but vain {@creature flesh golem} influenced by {@area Arborea|015|x} insists on following a character until the character sketches, sculpts, or otherwise artistically renders it.
translated: 一具被{@area 奔放之野|015|x}所影響的美麗但虛榮的{@creature 血肉魔像}堅持要跟著某名角色，直到該角色以素描、雕塑或者其他藝術形式來描繪它。

english: A {@creature clay golem} influenced by {@area the Beastlands|01d|x} has been transformed into the walking hive that's home to numerous {@creature Swarm of Wasps||swarms of insects (wasps)}.
translated: 一個被{@area 萬獸鄉|01d|x}所影響的{@creature 粘土魔像}已經變成了一個行走的蜂巢，是許多{@creature 黃蜂群||昆蟲叢集（黃蜂）}的家園。

english: A kindly {@creature green hag} influenced by {@area Elysium|02a|x} invites passersby to join her for tea in her cottage made of sweets. She makes some of the best cookies in the Outlands.
translated: 一位被{@area 極樂境|02a|x}所影響的友善{@creature 綠鬼婆}邀請過路人到她的由糖果製成的小屋裡來喝茶。她製作的一些餅乾在外域中堪稱最佳。

english: A gnarled {@creature dryad} influenced by {@area Carceri|026|x} seeks to entrap creatures within the root-snarled, prison-like cavern beneath her grove.
translated: 一個被{@area 卡瑟利|026|x}所影響的扭曲的{@creature 樹精}試圖把其他生物困在她的樹叢下的一個根系纏繞、如監獄一般的洞穴中。

english: A {@creature nycaloth} seeks to capture several monochromatic {@creature Hell Hound||hell hounds} influenced by {@area Gehenna|02e|x}. The yugoloth seeks to sell the hounds to Fiends participating in the Blood War.
translated: 一個{@creature 征伐羅斯魔}試圖捕捉幾隻受{@area 焦炎火獄|02e|x}影響的{@creature 地獄獵犬||地獄獵犬}，這隻尤格羅斯魔yugoloth打算將這些地獄犬賣給正在參與血戰的邪魔。

english: An {@creature ettin} influenced by {@area the Beastlands|01d|x} has one head with bovine features and one head with lupine features. It desperately needs help finding something both heads are willing to eat.
translated: 一個被{@area 萬獸鄉|01d|x}所影響的{@creature 雙頭巨人}有著一個牛外形的頭與一個狼外形的頭。它迫切的需要幫助，找到一些兩個頭都願意吃的東西。

english: Several gnome {@creature Mage||mages} seek help recovering their walking castle from a band of aggressive, spine-covered {@creature lizardfolk} influenced by {@area the Abyss|00b|x}.
translated: 幾名侏儒{@creature 魔法師||魔法師們}尋求幫助以從一夥被{@area 無底深淵|00b|x}所影響的、脊柱外露的好戰的{@creature 蜥蜴人}手裡奪回他們的移動城堡。

english: The characters have to retrieve a treasure from a group of mischievous {@creature Sprite||sprites}. The sprites are secretly defended by {@creature Mimic||mimics} influenced by {@area Elysium|02a|x} that take the form of tiny, whimsical cottages.
translated: 角色們不得不從一夥淘氣的{@creature 小仙靈||小仙靈}手中奪回一份財寶。這些小仙靈被一隻受{@area 極樂境|02a|x}影響的{@creature 擬身怪||擬身怪}變成奇形怪狀的微型小屋的形狀暗中保護了起來。

english: A {@creature drider} influenced by {@area Arborea|015|x} runs a {@creature giant spider} ranch. She hires the characters to hunt a rare breed of {@creature sunfly|MPP} (detailed {@area later|07a|x} in this book) that, when fed to her spiders, will allow them to produce a remarkable type of silk.
translated: 一隻被{@area 奔放之野|015|x}所影響的{@creature 蛛化卓爾}經營著一個{@creature 巨蜘蛛}牧場。她僱傭角色們去搜尋一種稀有的{@creature 日光螢|MPP}（詳見本書{@area 後文|07a|x}），當餵給蜘蛛時可以使它們製出一種非凡的絲綢。

english: Within a {@creature gelatinous cube} influenced by {@area Gehenna|02e|x} floats a gigantic fiendish skull. Numerous Fiends revere the cube and interpret depraved schemes and threatening orders from its quivering. A Celestial seeks aid in destroying the cube.
translated: 一個被{@area 焦炎火獄|02e|x}所影響的{@creature 凝膠方塊}體內漂浮著一顆巨大的邪魔頭骨。無數的邪魔崇拜它並從它的抖動中解讀邪惡的計劃與令人恐懼的命令。一位天族尋求幫助以摧毀該方塊。

english: A {@creature banshee} influenced by {@area Acheron|010|x} appears as a fallen knight-commander with a legion of {@creature Specter||specters}. Guardians of the gate-town of Rigus hire the characters to help banish the phantom army.
translated: 一隻被{@area 修羅場|010|x}所影響的{@creature 報喪妖}以墮落騎士指揮官的形象出現，麾下統領著一支{@creature 惡靈||惡靈}軍團。外域門鎮悍鬥堡的守衛者們僱傭角色們驅逐這批惡靈軍隊。

english: Allowed into the {@area forum|10d|x} on an ancient contract, a silver-tongued {@creature pit fiend} invites Excelsior's orators to debate the worth of a soul. An angel asks the characters to take the podium.
translated: 根據一份古老的契約，一名巧舌如簧的{@creature 深獄煉魔}得以進入{@area 大論壇|10d|x}。他邀請精益城裡的各位辯論者探討一個靈魂的價值究竟有多少。一名天使希望角色們能走上講臺。

english: The faith of a divine champion ({@creature gladiator}) begins to waver in the {@area Chandelier|10c|x}, causing their cloud keep to shudder. A {@creature lantern archon|MPP} (see {@book Morte's Planar Parade|MPP}) asks the characters to erase the warrior's doubt before their fortress falls from the sky.
translated: 在{@area 吊燈|10c|x}，一名神聖勇士（{@creature 角鬥士}）的信仰開始動搖，導致他們的雲上堡壘劇烈搖晃。一名{@creature 聖光神使|MPP}（見{@book 莫提的位面遊記|MPP}）請求角色們在這位戰士的堡壘從天空墜落之前消除他的疑慮。

english: A {@creature sea hag} in the {@area Sacred Well|128|x} tells one of the characters they will die at the hand of Gzemnid in five days.
translated: 一個{@area 聖井|128|x}中的{@creature 海鬼婆}告知一位角色，這位角色會在五天內死在格澤姆尼德手中。

english: The avatar of an evil deity of war (use the {@creature planar incarnate|MPP} stat block from {@book Morte's Planar Parade|MPP}) emerges from the {@area Lion's Gate|0e4|x} to destroy Rigus.
translated: 一位邪惡戰爭神祇的化身（使用《{@book 莫提的位面遊記|MPP}》中的{@creature 位面顯化|MPP}資料塊）從{@area 獅門|0e4|x}出現，意欲摧毀悍鬥堡。

english: A {@creature mummy lord} in the {@area Crown|149|x} commands General Braahg to implement an outdated strategy. Risking treason, the hobgoblin hires the characters to lay his superior to rest.
translated: {@area 將冠區|149|x}的一位{@creature 木乃伊領主}命令布拉格將軍實施一項過時的戰略，冒著叛國風險，這位大地精僱傭角色們令他的上司安息。

english: Faction members openly share information with you. Additionally, the first time your Renown score reaches 50, you can undertake voluntary mutations to enhance your physiology. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws made to avoid or end the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} and {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} conditions.
translated: 派系成員會與你開誠佈公地共享資訊。此外，你的聲望值首次達到50時，你可以接受自願的變異來強化生理機能。你為避免或終止{@condition 受擒|XPHB}和{@condition 中毒|XPHB}狀態而進行的豁免檢定具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}。

english: Vigilant. While holding or wearing this item, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} rolls and Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks.
translated: 警醒。持握或穿戴此物品期間，你的{@variantrule 先攻|XPHB}擲骰和感知（{@skill 察覺|XPHB}）檢定具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}。
